classifiedIssues.title: WebKit recorded M14 state persistence across route navigation (/farm/uppsala-demo/results -> /farm/uppsala-demo/decisions)
classifiedIssues.rootCause: In src/hooks/use-astragron-store.tsx, persistPrefs previously serialized closure state values when setViewComplexity('SCIENTIFIC') was called immediately after setDatasetMode('RECORDED_M14_RESEARCH'), overwriting datasetMode in localStorage before the next full page navigation in WebKit.

classifiedIssues.title: WebKit Heilbronn autocomplete option visibility in PlaceSearchBox on /farm/new (SF-1)
classifiedIssues.rootCause: In src/components/maps/place-search-box.tsx, WebKit programmatic fill/scroll interaction after validation alert can either miss focus/open state or delay the 300ms debounce/accessible option name matching unless open is enforced on input change and aria-label / role=option semantics are explicit.

classifiedIssues.title: Satellite 403 -> VECTOR_MAP recovery remains in REMOTE_LOADING (Chromium & WebKit in e2e/v4-review-regressions.spec.ts)
classifiedIssues.rootCause: In src/components/maps/maplibre-globe-canvas.tsx, openfreemap vector tiles are already defined and loaded during initial SATELLITE_HYBRID load; when switching to VECTOR_MAP, remoteTilesLoadedRef was reset to 0 while map.setStyle diff kept the already-loaded openfreemap source without re-firing tile load events, leaving renderStatus at REMOTE_LOADING.

classifiedIssues.title: 5 km benchmark proximity halo in evaluateSiteCapabilityCheck
classifiedIssues.rootCause: src/server/capability-overlay-service.ts used BENCHMARK_MATCH_RADIUS_KM = 5.0 and polygon-contains-benchmark-point matching, allowing an arbitrary user farm near Uppsala/Nyeri/Wagga to inherit benchmark status instead of requiring explicit benchmark site/farm identity and unmodified geometry.

classifiedIssues.title: FTW partial row-group / candidate scan returning conclusive NO_RELIABLE_BOUNDARY
classifiedIssues.rootCause: src/server/ftw-boundary-service.ts capped row groups (MAX_PRUNED_ROW_GROUPS = 4) and geometry candidates (MAX_GEOMETRY_CANDIDATES = 6) without distinguishing exhaustive search from budget-limited partial search (SEARCH_INCOMPLETE_LIMIT vs NO_MATCH_AFTER_COMPLETE_SEARCH) or exposing totalMatchedRowGroups / searchExhaustive metadata and user cancellation.

classifiedIssues.title: Stale delivery manifest and verify-manifest.mjs target mismatch
classifiedIssues.rootCause: scripts/verify-manifest.mjs checked review/12_HASHES_AND_DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json from an earlier milestone instead of an authoritative current release manifest generated from the shipped V7 files.
